scope_distinctions: Heading reports an unnamed alternative interpretation, not consensus or an explicit Tabari preference.
Following named report attributes abundant good to Ibn Abbas through Said ibn Jubayr; its names are not assigned as sole originating voice of the heading.
Following Abu Bishr/Said exchange says the river is included within the good; preserve separately as T03.
Earlier river heading remains T01; alternative meanings must not be collapsed or treated as necessarily mutually exclusive.
